shortDescription: Manages BGP EVPN configuration on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: advertise_l2vpn_evpn
options.description: Enable or disable a device to advertise IP routes imported to a VPN instance to its EVPN instance.

options.name: advertise_router_type
options.description: Configures a device to advertise routes to its BGP EVPN peers.

options.name: as_number
options.description: Specifies integral AS number. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 4294967295.

options.name: bgp_instance
options.description: Name of a BGP instance. The value is a string of 1 to 31 case-sensitive characters, spaces not supported.

options.name: peer_address
options.description: Specifies the IPv4 address of a BGP EVPN peer. The value is in dotted decimal notation.

options.name: peer_enable
options.description: Enable or disable a BGP device to exchange routes with a specified peer or peer group in the address family view.

options.name: peer_group_name
options.description: Specify the name of a peer group that BGP peers need to join. The value is a string of 1 to 47 case-sensitive characters, spaces not supported.

options.name: state
options.description: Manage the state of the resource.

options.name: vpn_name
options.description: Associates a specified VPN instance with the IPv4 address family. The value is a string of 1 to 31 case-sensitive characters, spaces not supported.
